name: laser Designator
effect: Attack Invisible target with -8 Flat Difficuty instead of Invisible 50/50
on_hit: The target gains lock on, loses Invisible and Hidden
on_crit: At T2 target gains Exposed untill it loses lock on. A character can only be affected by this once per scene.

name: Hound Missile
effect: Can only be fired at Altitude 20 or lower

name: Laser Guided HE Missile
effect: Can only be fired at Altitude 20 or lower and if the target has lock on this missile does not miss

name: Rocket Pods
effect: Can only be fired at Altitude 10 or lower | You may deploy the line attack X many spaces you are in the air I.E. If you are altitude 10 then you can start deploying the line 10 spaces from you.

name: Torpedo
effect: Can only be fired at Altitude 10 or lower

name: Drone Type: Hover
effect: All movement is considered hovering. This drone can only hover as high as 5/10/13 off the ground and cant take fall damage.

name: R.O.G.E.R. Specs
effect: This drone has the capacity for 1/2/4 Weapon Systems and 2/2/4 Weapons. Also requires a Drone Type to be chosen: Fixed Wing or Hover

name: Drone Type: Fixed Wing
effect:
All movement is considered flying and is required to move atleast half its normal movement rounded up or it starts falling at the end of its turn to which its Stunned till the end of combat.
All movement is required to be in a straight line.
At altitude 10 or lower gain 1 accuracy on offensive actions, at altitude 20 gain soft cover, at altitude 30 gain hard cover.

name: Expanded System: Bomb Bay
effect: Have a Copy of a bomb bay as a system

name: Expanded System: Missile & Torpedo Bay
effect: Have a copy of a launcher weapon

name: Weapon System: Bomb Bay
effect:
As a quick action you may choose which ordnance to use at a [X] cost and then mark the target area. The enemies will know the target area.
Bombs fall 10 spaces at the end of your turn.

Light Bomb [1] | Blast 1 1d6 Explosive
Medium Bomb [2] | Blast 2 1d6+4 Explosive
Heavy Bomb [3] | Blast 3 1d6+8 Explosive
